```mcstas
# D22 SANS instrument in McStas
# Parameters: lambda=4.5, dlambda=0.45, D22_collimation=2, D22_sample=H2O_liq.qSq

# Define constants
gR0 = 1
gQc = 0.0216
gAlpha = 4.07
gW = 1.0/300.0
Al_Thickness = 0.001
gGap = 0.001
sT3 = 413.5
sI3 = 1.022e+13
sT2 = 145.8
sI2 = 3.44e+13
sT1 = 40.1
sI1 = 2.78e+13

# Define D22_nu
D22_nu = 3956*48.3*DEG2RAD/2/PI/lambda/0.25

# Load components
include "mcstas_components.mcstas"

# Define the instrument
instrument D22_SANS (
  lambda = 4.5,
  dlambda = 0.45,
  D22_collimation = 2,
  D22_sample = "H2O_liq.qSq"
) {
  # Source
  source_gen(
    name = "HCS",
    radius = 0.21/2,
    dist = 2.155,
    focus_xw = 0.123,
    focus_yh = 0.120,
    lambda0 = lambda,
    dlambda = dlambda,
    I1 = sI1,
    T1 = sT1,
    I2 = sI2,
    T2 = sT2,
    I3 = sI3,
    T3 = sT3,
    verbose = 1
  )

  # Collimation
  powderN(
    name = "HCS_Al",
    reflections = "Al.laz",
    yheight = 0.12,
    xwidth = 0.17,
    zdepth = Al_Thickness,
    p_inc = 0.005,
    p_transmit = 0.9450,
    d_phi = 10,
    p_interact = 0.05
  )

  # Monitor after collimation
  monitor_nD(
    name = "H5",
    xwidth = 0.04+0.004+0.015+0.004+0.06,
    yheight = 0.12,
    bins = 50,
    options = "x y, slit"
  )

  # H51 origin
  monitor_nD(
    name = "H51_origin",
    xwidth = 0.04+0.004+0.015+0.004+0.06,
    yheight = 0.12,
    bins = 50,
    options = "x y, slit"
  )

  # H51_start
  arm(
    name = "H51_Start",
    x = 0,
    y = 0,
    z = 0
  )

  # H51_obt_1
  guide_gravity(
    name = "H51_Obt_1",
    w1 = 0.04,
    h1 = 0.12,
    l = 2.775,
    R0 = gR0,
    Qc = gQc,
    alpha = gAlpha,
    m = 1.2,
    W = gW
  )

  # H51_obt_2
  guide_gravity(
    name = "H51_Obt_2",
    w1 = 0.04,
    h1 = 0.12,
    l = 2.775,
    R0 = gR0,
    Qc = gQc,
    alpha = gAlpha,
    m = 1.2,
    W = gW
  )

  # H51_obt_3
  guide_gravity(
    name = "H51_Obt_3",
    w1 = 0.04,
    h1 = 0.12,
    l = 2.775,
    R0 = gR0,
    Qc = gQc,
    alpha = gAlpha,
    m = 1.2,
    W = gW
  )

  # HCS_Al_H51
  powderN(
    name = "HCS_Al_H51",
    reflections = "Al.laz",
    yheight = 0.12,
    xwidth = 0.17,
    zdepth = Al_Thickness,
    p_inc = 0.005,
    p_transmit = 0.9450,
    d_phi = 10,
    p_interact = 0.05
  )

  # H512_VTE
  monitor_nD(
    name = "H512_VTE",
    xwidth = 0.04+0.004+0.015+0.004+0.06,
    yheight = 0.12,
    bins = 50,
    options = "x y, slit"
  )

  # HCS_Al_copy_5
  powderN(
    name = "HCS_Al_copy_5",
    reflections = "Al.laz",
    yheight = 0.12,
    xwidth = 0.17,
    zdepth = Al_Thickness,
    p_inc = 0.005,
    p_transmit = 0.9450,
    d_phi = 10,
    p_interact = 0.05
  )

  # H51_S78
  guide_gravity(
    name = "H51_S78",
    w1 = 0.04,
    h1 = 0.12,
    l = 2.775,
    R0 = gR0,
    Qc = gQc,
    alpha = gAlpha,
    m = 1.2,
    W = gW
  )

  # H51_S78_copy
  guide_gravity(
    name = "H51_S78_copy",
    w1 = 0.04,
    h1 = 0.12,
    l = 2.775,
    R0 = gR0,
    Qc = gQc,
    alpha = gAlpha,
    m = 1.2,
    W = gW
  )

  # H51_S78_copy_0
  guide_gravity(
    name = "H51_S78_copy_0",
    w1 = 0.04,
    h1 = 0.12,
    l = 2.775,
    R0 = gR0,
    Qc = gQc,
    alpha = gAlpha,
    m = 1.2,
    W = gW
  )

  # H51_S78_copy_1
  guide_gravity(
    name = "H51_S78_copy_1",
    w1 = 0.04,
    h1 = 0.12,
    l = 2.775,
    R0 = gR0,
    Qc = gQc,
    alpha = gAlpha,
    m = 1.2,
    W = gW
  )

  # HCS_Al_copy_6
  powderN(
    name = "HCS_Al_copy_6",
    reflections = "Al.laz",
    yheight = 0.12,
    xwidth = 0.17,
    zdepth = Al_Thickness,
    p_inc = 0.005,
    p_transmit = 0.9450,
    d_phi = 10,
    p_interact = 0.05
  )

  # H512_S11
  guide_gravity(
    name = "H512_S11",
    w1 = 0.04,
    h1 = 0.12,
    l = 2.775,
    R0 = gR0,
    Qc = gQc,
    alpha = gAlpha,
    m = 1.2,
    W = gW
  )

  # HCS_Al_copy_7
  powderN(
    name = "HCS_Al_copy_7",
    reflections = "Al.laz",
    yheight = 0.12,
    xwidth = 0.17,
    zdepth = Al_Thickness,
    p_inc = 0.005,
    p_transmit = 0.9450,
    d_phi = 10,
    p_interact = 0.05
  )

  # D22_PreV
  monitor_nD(
    name = "D22_PreV",
    xwidth = 0.04,
    yheight = 0.05,
    bins = 50,
    restore_neutron = 1,
    options = "x y"
  )

  # D22_Vselector
  v_selector(
    name = "D22_Vselector",
    xwidth = 0.04,
    yheight = 0.05,
    zdepth = 0.30,
    radius = 0.12,
    alpha = 48.3,
    length = 0.25,
    d = 0.0004,
    nu = D22_nu,
    nslit = 72
  )

  # D22_Collimation
  guide_gravity(
    name = "D22_Collimation",
    w1 = 0.04,
    h1 = 0.12,
    l = 2.775,
    R0 = gR0,
    Qc = gQc,
    alpha = gAlpha,
    m = 1.2,
    W = gW
  )

  # D22_Sample_Pos
  arm(
    name = "D22_Sample_Pos",
    x = 0,
    y = 0,
    z = 20+0.3
  )

  # H51_D22_Sample_Div
  monitor_nD(
    name = "H51_D22_Sample_Div",
    xwidth = 0.02,
    yheight = 0.05,
    bins = 100,
    restore_neutron = 1,
    options = "dx limits=[-2 2], dy limits=[-2 2]"
  )

  # H51_D22_Sample_XY
  monitor_nD(
    name = "H51_D22_Sample_XY",
    xwidth = 0.02,
    yheight = 0.05,
    bins = 50,
    restore_neutron = 1,
    options = "x y"
  )

  # H51_D22_Sample_L
  monitor_nD(
    name = "H51_D22_Sample_L",
    xwidth = 0.02,
    yheight = 0.05,
    bins = 50,
    restore_neutron = 1,
    options = "lambda limits=[1 10]"
  )

  # D22_Sample
  isotropic_sqw(
    name = "D22_Sample",
    Sqw_coh = D22_sample,
    Sqw_inc = NULL,
    radius = 0.005,
    yheight = 0.05,
    d_phi = RAD2DEG*atan2(1, D22_collimation)
  )

  # D22_Detector
  monitor_nD(
    name = "D22_Detector",
    xwidth = 1,
    yheight = 1,
    bins = 128,
    options = "x y"
  )
}

# Run the instrument
run(
  seed = 123456789,
  ncount = 1e6
)

# Output the results
print("Integrated intensity on H5: ", get_monitor("H5").intensity, " ± ", get_monitor("H5").error, " events (ncount = ", ncount, ")")
print("Integrated intensity on H51_origin: ", get_monitor("H51_origin").intensity, " ± ", get_monitor("H51_origin").error, " events (ncount = ", ncount, ")")
print("Integrated intensity on H512_VTE: ", get_monitor("H512_VTE").intensity, " ± ", get_monitor("H512_VTE").error, " events (ncount = ", ncount, ")")
print("Integrated intensity on D22_PreV: ", get_monitor("D22_PreV").intensity, " ± ", get_monitor("D22_PreV").error, " events (ncount = ", ncount, ")")
print("Integrated intensity on H51_D22_Sample_Div: ", get_monitor("H51_D22_Sample_Div").intensity, " ± ", get_monitor("H51_D22_Sample_Div").error, " events (ncount = ", ncount, ")")
print("Integrated intensity on H51_D22_Sample_XY: ", get_monitor("H51_D22_Sample_XY").intensity, " ± ", get_monitor("H51_D22_Sample_XY").error, " events (ncount = ", ncount, ")")
print("Integrated intensity on H51_D22_Sample_L: ", get_monitor("H51_D22_Sample_L").intensity, " ± ", get_monitor("H51_D22_Sample_L").error, " events (ncount = ", ncount, ")")
print("Integrated intensity on D22_Detector: ", get_monitor("D22_Detector").intensity, " ± ", get_monitor("D22_Detector").error, " events (ncount = ", ncount, ")")
```
